9901.name: City Limits Of Ghenna

north.description: To the north lies A Fountain Of Tears.

east.description: To the east lies A Street In Ghenna.

south.description: To the south lies The Smell of Decay.

west.description: To the west lies The Streets Of Ghenna.

up.description: To the up lies On A Small Island In The Middle Of The Lake.

9901.description:
You stand inside the city limits of Ghenna, once a thriving barter town
and now a haven for the evil it bred under the proud Lord Suzerain.
Broken walls and fallen lintels crowd every corner, mixed with age-
whitened bones of all manner of beasts. Streets lead away north toward a
fountain, east and west into the ruined town, and south toward a
graveyard stench.

9902.name: A Fountain Of Tears

north.description: To the north lies A Road In Ghenna.

south.description: To the south lies City Limits Of Ghenna.

west.description: To the west lies A Culdesac.

9902.description:
A great fountain stands here against the city wall, brimming with the
tears of all who died within Ghenna. Strangely, the water is a clear and
shining blue, and it gives off a holiness that sits oddly in so foul a
place. The basin is wide and deep, ringed by cracked paving. A road
climbs north, a cul-de-sac opens west, and the square falls away south
toward the city limits.

extra_descs.fountain tears basin water:
The basin is filled with clear blue water said to be the tears of those
slain in Ghenna. It looks deep and wide, and it seems untouched by the
filth around it.

9903.name: The Smell of Decay

north.description: To the north lies City Limits Of Ghenna.

south.description: To the south lies The Twisting Hedges.

west.description: To the west lies The Streets Of Ghenna.

9903.description:
This is the town graveyard, if such a name can be given to it. Nobody
troubles to bury the dead in Ghenna, so corpses lie strewn about in no
kind of order, and the stench is overwhelming. Heaped bodies close off
the way along the far side. A road leads north to the city limits, a
hedge maze lies south, and a street opens west.

9904.name: A Culdesac

north.description: To the north lies Blood Tavern.

east.description: To the east lies A Fountain Of Tears.

west.description: To the west lies The Streets Of Ghenna.

9904.description:
A small cul-de-sac circles here on worn cobbles. A large fountain
glimmers just beyond the street, east of the circle, and a door lies to
the north beneath a tavern sign painted with something unspeakable. The
sign swings and creaks on rusted chains. The street leads back west.

9905.name: The Twisting Hedges

west.description: To the west lies A Dead End.

9905.description:
You are among a row of twisting hedges, seven feet tall, dense and dark
and cut into winding turns. Thorny shoots lean over the path as if
listening. The leaves are glossy with damp and smell like old cellars.
The hedge walls close in all round, and the only way through leads west.

9906.name: The Twisting Hedges
9906.description:
Twisting hedges stand seven feet tall on every side, cut into narrow,
winding turns. Black thorns jut from the branches and the ground is
spongy with fallen leaves. The air smells of rot and damp earth. Each
turn looks the same as the last, and the green walls mutter in the wind.

9907.name: The Twisting Hedges
9907.description:
You are lost among tall hedges whose dark leaves fold back on
themselves. The path forks and doubles around you, and a pale fungus
grows in the shade at the roots. A faint sweetness hangs in the air.
Somewhere a branch cracks, but nothing can be seen through the leaves.

9908.name: The Twisting Hedges
9908.description:
The hedges here are old and woody, their trunks as thick as a man's arm
and knotted with thorn. The path turns sharply and turns again, and a
scatter of small bones lies in the dust of one bend. A grey mist drifts
low along the ground. Overhead only a strip of sullen sky is visible.

9909.name: The Twisting Hedges
9909.description:
A maze of hedges encloses you, dense and glossy and tall. Dead leaves
lie ankle deep, and strands of torn cloth hang from the thorns. The path
loops round on itself so many times that you cannot say which way is
which. A cold wind combs through the branches with a dry whisper.

9910.name: The Realm Of The Hopeless

north.description: To the north lies An Undulating Room.

up.description: To the up lies City Limits Of Ghenna.

9910.description:
The wailing of souls in torment sends shivers up your spine. The walls,
floor and ceiling are a thick red mass that defies description. A rift
in the ceiling lets down a slight breeze that ruffles your hair. A way
leads north into a heaving room, and a gap rises overhead toward the
city limits.

9911.name: An Undulating Room

east.description: To the east lies A Wrinkle In The Fabric Of Time.

south.description: To the south lies The Realm Of The Hopeless.

9911.description:
The room undulates with an aura of terrible evil. The floor shifts under
your feet so that you stagger, and the ceiling pumps slowly above you
like a great muscle. You feel your strength draining from your limbs.
Passages lead east toward a spinning place and south into a red realm.

9914.name: The Streets Of Ghenna

east.description: To the east lies A Culdesac.

west.description: To the west lies A Musty Area Behind The Wall.

9914.description:
This is a plain and ordinary street, rolling gently over a shallow dale.
Dark windows watch from both sides and a damp wind pushes old rags along
the gutter. The road leads east toward a small circle of stones, and
west toward a musty gap behind a wall.

9915.name: Blood Tavern

north.description: To the north lies The Card Table.

south.description: To the south lies A Culdesac.

west.description: To the west lies The Card Table.

9915.description:
You stand inside Blood Tavern, a bizarre place at first sight. The
parquet floor creaks beneath an odd and shifting bar, and next to the
bar a stairwell vanishes upward into blackness. The ceiling is vaulted,
with three candled chandeliers that hang like victims overhead. A card
table stands to the north, and the door leads back out south.

9916.name: At The Undead Bar

south.description: To the south lies The Card Table.

up.description: To the up lies The Top Of The Stairs.

9916.description:
A long bar runs along the room, built of God knows what, and it seems to
be made of pale hide sewn with the hair of various beasts. Sturdy though
it is, it is pliant to the touch and seems to move ever so slightly, as
if alive. A dark stairwell leads upward from here. The card table lies
back south.

9917.name: The Card Table

north.description: To the north lies At The Undead Bar.

south.description: To the south lies Blood Tavern.

9917.description:
A card table made from the skeleton of some odd four-legged thing stands
here, with a few unplayed hands left on it. You wonder where the rest of
the poor players went. The room is dim and smells of tallow and old
wine. The tavern floor lies south, and the bar rises to the north.

9918.name: The Top Of The Stairs

east.description: To the east lies An Upstairs Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies An Upstairs Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies At The Undead Bar.

9918.description:
You stand at the top of the stairs in Blood Tavern. A small hallway runs
east and west in darkness, its boards sagging and warped. Cold air seeps
through the gaps in the plaster. Stairs lead down to the bar below.

9919.name: An Upstairs Hallway

north.description: To the north lies A Messy Bedroom.

west.description: To the west lies The Top Of The Stairs.

9919.description:
This is a small upstairs hallway, narrow and low, with a sour smell of
old smoke. Behind the door to the north you hear faint singing, a dusky
voice that sounds almost feminine. The planks creak with each step. The
top of the stairs lies back west.

9920.name: A Messy Bedroom

south.description: To the south lies An Upstairs Hallway.

9920.description:
A messy bedroom holds a badly stained bed and a simple roll-top desk
buried in dusty papers. A small window looks out over darkness. The
sheets lie in a tangle, and the air is stale with old perfume. The only
door leads south to the hallway.

9921.name: An Upstairs Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Top Of The Stairs.

south.description: To the south lies The Master Suite.

9921.description:
This upstairs hallway of Blood Tavern is dim and bare, with a threadbare
runner on the boards. A door stands to the south, closed against the
dark. The plaster has peeled in long strips, showing the laths beneath.
The top of the stairs lies east.

9922.name: The Master Suite

north.description: To the north lies An Upstairs Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Bathroom.

9922.description:
This is the master suite of Blood Tavern. A liquor cabinet stands
against one wall, full of dusty old bottles, and a king-sized bed faces
it across the room. Heavy curtains keep out all light. A half-open door
leads west into a washroom, and another leads back north to the hall.

9923.name: The Bathroom

north.description: To the north lies A Musty Area Behind The Wall.

east.description: To the east lies The Master Suite.

9923.description:
The washroom stinks of damp and old rot. A basin sits on the floor,
filled with water that is stained dark red, and a dirty mirror reflects
your face back at you in fragments. The tiles are cracked and sticky. A
door leads east to the suite, and another to the north opens on a musty
gap.

9924.name: A Wrinkle In The Fabric Of Time

east.description: To the east lies The Twisting Hedges.

south.description: To the south lies A Labyrinth Of Bodies.

west.description: To the west lies An Undulating Room.

down.description: To the down lies The Streets Of Ghenna.

9924.description:
You are caught in a swirling vortex of time that turns your stomach. You
spin and spin, unsure which way is which, and the colours smear into a
grey blur around you. It seems you could end up in any of several
places. Ways lead east, south, and west, and a gap in the floor drops
down toward a street.

9925.name: A Labyrinth Of Bodies
9925.description:
You stand within a labyrinth made of bodies stacked ten feet high,
forming crooked corridors of limbs and cloth. Some of them are still
warm, and now and then a cry of despair rises from the mass. The air is
thick with the smell of death. No path out can be seen.

9926.name: A Labyrinth Of Bodies
9926.description:
You are standing within a labyrinth made of bodies stacked ten feet
high. Some are still warm, and now and then a moan of despair rises from
the mass. The passages bend like the coils of a maze, and the smell is
thick enough to taste.

9927.name: A Labyrinth Of Bodies
9927.description:
A wall of stacked bodies rises ten feet on every hand, packed tight in
crooked rows. Some are still warm, and a long moan of despair comes from
deep inside. Clammy air presses on your face. The corridor curls away
and doubles back on itself.

9928.name: A Labyrinth Of Bodies
9928.description:
Corpses are piled ten feet high to form this twisting passage. A few of
them are still warm, and from somewhere within the mass comes a muffled
scream. A cold sweat of fear runs down your back. The floor is slick and
uneven under your feet.

9929.name: A Labyrinth Of Bodies
9929.description:
The labyrinth of bodies is stacked ten feet high here, and pale limbs
hang across the path. Some of the bodies are still warm, and a thin plea
for aid sounds from the heap. The air is heavy and tastes of copper. The
turns of the passage seem to shift as you watch.

9930.name: A Labyrinth Of Bodies
9930.description:
This stretch of the labyrinth is built of bodies stacked ten feet high,
leaning together overhead. Some are still warm, and a gurgling cry of
despair bubbles from the mass. The floor is wet and the dim light is the
colour of old tallow. Every turn leads to another turn.

9931.name: A Labyrinth Of Bodies
9931.description:
You stand in a narrow lane between stacks of bodies ten feet tall. Some
are still warm, and a shriek of horror breaks from the pile and dies
away. The stack sways a little as if breathing. The path winds on among
the dead with no end in sight.

9932.name: A Labyrinth Of Bodies

west.description: To the west lies A Messy Bedroom.

9932.description:
The passage between the stacked bodies narrows here, rising ten feet on
either side. Some of the dead are still warm, and an occasional cry of
despair stirs the silence. A faint draught from a doorway carries the
smell of old sheets and stale scent. A way leads west out of the stack.

9933.name: The Mouth Of A Large Cave

up.description: To the up lies Inside The Cave Entrance.

9933.description:
Out of the labyrinth at last, you stand at the mouth of a large cave
about a hundred feet across. A steady trickle of blood runs down worn
stone steps that climb into the hill above. The rock is stained dark and
the air is hot and sour. Dare you go up?

9934.name: Inside The Cave Entrance

north.description: To the north lies Eaten to Pieces.

up.description: To the up lies A Cramped Grotto.

down.description: To the down lies The Mouth Of A Large Cave.

9934.description:
You are inside the cave entrance, where a strong smell of sulfur makes
you gag. Great stone steps lead down to the place of stacked bodies. A
steady stream of blood trickles from somewhere to the north, where a
sound like a giant bellows can be heard. A narrow ledge climbs up into a
cramped hollow.

9935.name: Eaten to Pieces

north.description: To the north lies The Lair Entrance.

south.description: To the south lies Inside The Cave Entrance.

9935.description:
The reek of sulfur grows stronger here, and about a hundred horribly
disfigured corpses lie across the floor of rock. It looks as though the
flesh was eaten from their bodies while they still lived. The stream of
blood from the entrance is much wider here. The cave leads north toward
the source and south back toward the entrance.

9936.name: The Lair Entrance

south.description: To the south lies Eaten to Pieces.

up.description: To the up lies The Lair Of The Deep Dragon.

9936.description:
This is an arched cavern of great size, high as a cathedral. A ledge of
rock juts out far overhead and sends down a steady gush of blood and
entrails. A raucous sound of crunching and a slurp here and there turns
your stomach. A rough slope climbs on to a ledge, and a passage leads
back south.

9937.name: The Lair Of The Deep Dragon

up.description: To the up lies Under the bones..

down.description: To the down lies The Lair Entrance.

9937.description:
This ledge is slippery with the blood of hundreds who came here and did
not leave. Corpses lie everywhere, and a black steaming substance
smeared over the rock gives off the awful sulfur smell. You feel certain
your life may end soon. A slope leads down, and a bone-choked hollow
opens above.

9938.name: A Cramped Grotto

west.description: To the west lies The Adit.

down.description: To the down lies Inside The Cave Entrance.

9938.description:
You are in a cramped grotto over the cave entrance. Even if you are not
afraid of tight places, this one will make you so. The rock presses
close on every side and you must keep your head down. A crawlspace leads
west, and a ledge drops down to the entrance.

9939.name: The Adit

north.description: To the north lies A Crawlspace.

east.description: To the east lies A Cramped Grotto.

9939.description:
The grotto widens into an adit tall enough to stand in. Stalagmites and
stalactites jut from floor and ceiling like the teeth of a great jaw.
Water drips with a slow, steady beat. A passage leads north, and the
narrow grotto lies back east.

9940.name: A Crawlspace

east.description: To the east lies Abode Of The Efreeti.

9940.description:
This crawlspace is barely passable. It bends to the right, and you
cannot tell where it leads. The rock is close, rough and warm against
your shoulders. A glow of lamplight spills in from the east, and there
is no way back the way you came.

9941.name: Abode Of The Efreeti

west.description: To the west lies A Crawlspace.

up.description: To the up lies Under the bones..

9941.description:
You have entered the magical abode of a great efreeti, done in a style
from far-off lands. The room glimmers with every comfort a being could
want: pillows, rugs and brass candelabra are everywhere, and silk hangs
from the ceiling. A heavy sweet incense hangs in the warm air. A narrow
crawl leads out west, and a stair of bones rises upward.

9943.name: A Musty Area Behind The Wall

south.description: To the south lies The Bathroom.

down.description: To the down lies On The Stairs.

9943.description:
You are in a musty hidden space behind the wall of the washroom. Dust
lies thick and grey on the boards, and spider silk hangs in ropes. A
very narrow granite staircase leads down from here into darkness. A door
lies south.

9944.name: The Bottom Of The Granite Staircase

east.description: To the east lies A Backwall Niche.

up.description: To the up lies The Granite Staircase.

9944.description:
You have reached the bottom of the granite staircase, the cellar of
Blood Tavern. A hole in the ceiling is stained black, above a great heap
of refuse and rotting sacking. Walls stand close on every other side,
but a way passes east around the heap. The stair rises back up.

9945.name: The Granite Staircase

up.description: To the up lies On The Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Bottom Of The Granite Staircase.

9945.description:
The granite staircase winds on, its steps narrow and uneven, worn hollow
in the middle by long use. Faint scratches mark the stone where
something once dragged itself along. The darkness below smells of old
wine and wet brick. You may climb back up or descend further.

9946.name: On The Stairs

up.description: To the up lies A Musty Area Behind The Wall.

down.description: To the down lies The Granite Staircase.

9946.description:
You are on a narrow granite staircase that spirals gently downward. The
stone is worn into hollows by long use and slick with damp. A thin cold
draught climbs the shaft from below. You may go up toward the hidden
space or down into the dark.

9947.name: A Backwall Niche

north.description: To the north lies Pathway To Power.

west.description: To the west lies The Bottom Of The Granite Staircase.

9947.description:
This niche behind the back wall is dank, dark and dusty. The brick shows
the signs of decay, red and black flakes littering the floor. An old
cask of port lies broken in one corner, a relic from happier times. A
door leads north, and the way back lies west.

9948.name: Pathway To Power

north.description: To the north lies Surrounded By Flames.

east.description: To the east lies A Makeshift Bedroom.

south.description: To the south lies A Backwall Niche.

9948.description:
You land in a heap beside a small hole in the floor, and a smell of
cooking drifts up out of it. The stone is hot under your hands. A dull
red glow shows from the passage ahead. Ways lead north into the glow,
east through a door, and south back to the niche.

9949.name: Surrounded By Flames

north.description: To the north lies The Seat Of Power.

south.description: To the south lies Pathway To Power.

9949.description:
You seem to have stepped into a little corner of hell. Flames dance on
the walls and make the light play tricks on your eyes. A dark figure can
just be made out to the north. The way south leads back the way you
came.

9950.name: A Makeshift Bedroom

west.description: To the west lies Pathway To Power.

9950.description:
A cot lies against the far wall of this small alcove, directly beneath
an inverted pentagram scribed in dark red. A bound footlocker stands
opposite. The air is stale and tinged with sulfur. The only exit is the
door back west.

9951.name: The Streets Of Ghenna

east.description: To the east lies The Smell of Decay.

west.description: To the west lies The Streets Of Ghenna.

9951.description:
The cobbled road is slick with the blood of many a wayward adventurer,
and your boots slide on it. Dark stains run in the cracks and into the
gutters. Ragged house fronts lean in on either side. The street goes on
east toward the graveyard smell and west into the streets of the town.

9952.name: The Seat Of Power

south.description: To the south lies Surrounded By Flames.

up.description: To the up lies Under the bones..

9952.description:
Fire rages on every side. A black marble dais rises among the flames,
bearing a black marble chair that is conspicuously empty. It is plainly
a throne of some sort. The flames make every way impassable but the one
you came by, to the south, and a holy way that climbs upward.

extra_descs.throne chair dais:
A black marble chair stands on a black marble dais. It is cold to look
at, though fire licks at its feet, and it is conspicuously empty.

9953.name: Under the bones.

up.description: To the up lies The Smell of Decay.

9953.description:
You lie beneath a loose heap of stacked bones, a barrow of the unburied.
Through the empty eye socket of a human skull above you, a pale night
sky shows. The bones shift and clatter with every breath. With a small
effort you could free yourself and climb up out of the pile.

9954.name: The Streets Of Ghenna

north.description: To the north lies The Streets Of Ghenna.

east.description: To the east lies The Streets Of Ghenna.

south.description: To the south lies A Dead End.

9954.description:
The street runs between stained house fronts, the high city wall
blocking the way beyond. The paving is cracked and sunken, with pools of
black water in the dips. Shutters bang somewhere in the dark. The street
leads on north and south, and a lane opens east.

9955.name: The Streets Of Ghenna

north.description: To the north lies The Streets Of Ghenna.

east.description: To the east lies A Burned Out Building.

south.description: To the south lies The Streets Of Ghenna.

9955.description:
A street runs north and south here, its cobbles battering your feet with
every step. The tall city wall stands close beside it. A burned-out
building leans nearby, barely upright in the thin wind that whistles
through. Charred beams show against the sky, and you can go north,
south, or east into the ruin.

9956.name: A Burned Out Building

west.description: To the west lies The Streets Of Ghenna.

9956.description:
Charred rubble fills this ruined shell, and a fallen beam lies across a
skeleton bleached white with age. Soot clings to what remains of the
walls, and ash lies in drifts over the floor. The whole place creaks and
could crumble at any moment. The cobbled street lies back west through
the broken doorway.

9957.name: The Streets Of Ghenna

east.description: To the east lies City Limits Of Ghenna.

south.description: To the south lies The Streets Of Ghenna.

9957.description:
You are on a corner of the street, with the city wall rising close at
hand. A shuttered doorway stares out from the stones across the way,
bolted and silent. Dead leaves and ash drift in the corner. From here
the street runs east toward the city limits and south along the wall.

9959.name: A Street In Ghenna

east.description: To the east lies A City Street In Ghenna.

west.description: To the west lies City Limits Of Ghenna.

9959.description:
The narrow street is dim, with only a smear of light from far overhead.
Rubble from fallen houses chokes every side alley and spills into the
gutters. The street runs east into deeper darkness and west toward the
city entrance.

9960.name: A City Street In Ghenna

north.description: To the north lies The Trading Post.

east.description: To the east lies A City Street In Ghenna.

south.description: To the south lies A Trashed Abode.

west.description: To the west lies A Street In Ghenna.

9960.description:
So much filth litters the street here that you must zigzag around it. A
bare doorframe is all that remains of the house on the south side,
standing alone in a heap of broken stone. The house to the north looks a
little more whole. The street goes on a long way west, and runs east
toward a heap of rubble and the city wall.

9961.name: The Trading Post

south.description: To the south lies A City Street In Ghenna.

9961.description:
This was once the trading post, a hall as large as an auditorium. A dais
stands at the far end with a toppled podium upon it, and wooden benches
lie tipped over in every reach of the floor. Dust and cobwebs mask the
long tables where bargains were struck. The cobbled street lies just
beyond the doorway to the south.

9962.name: A Trashed Abode

north.description: To the north lies A City Street In Ghenna.

up.description: To the up lies Upstairs In A Trashed Abode.

9962.description:
This place was once a lovely home. The furniture is smashed to
splinters, though it still hints at a grand and stately age, and
cushions lie slit and spilled across the floor. A rickety stair climbs
to the upper floor but does not look safe. The street lies through the
door to the north.

9963.name: Upstairs In A Trashed Abode

north.description: To the north lies A Child's Room.

down.description: To the down lies A Trashed Abode.

9963.description:
Things look no better on the upper floor. The ceiling has caved in on
both sides and buried the passages under rotting beams, and foul mildew
has grown thick over the debris. A door hangs by one hinge at the north
end of the landing. The stair leads down.

9964.name: A Child's Room

south.description: To the south lies Upstairs In A Trashed Abode.

west.description: To the west lies A Vandalized Closet.

9964.description:
This was evidently a child's room. Broken toys lie scattered over the
boards, and a mattress leans against the far wall, slashed down the
middle with its stuffing heaped on the floor. A small painted horse lies
on its side with its legs snapped. A closet door gapes to the west, and
the landing lies back south.

9965.name: A Vandalized Closet

east.description: To the east lies A Child's Room.

down.description: To the down lies An Undulating Room.

9965.description:
This is a small walk-in closet, hung with children's clothes that are
stiff with mildew. Shoe boxes lie crushed and scattered on the floor,
and the shelves have been torn from the plaster. A hatch in the floor
leads down into a heaving place. The only other way is back east.

9966.name: A City Street In Ghenna

north.description: To the north lies A North-South Street In Ghenna.

south.description: To the south lies A Covered Walkway.

west.description: To the west lies A City Street In Ghenna.

9966.description:
This is a street of broken cobbles, with the city wall rising close
beside it. Corpses lie sprawled along the gutters, so many that you must
pick your steps with care. Flies drone over the stones and a cold wind
rattles the loose slates above. The street runs north and west, while a
covered walkway opens to the south.

9967.name: A Road In Ghenna

east.description: To the east lies A Bend In The Road.

south.description: To the south lies A Fountain Of Tears.

9967.description:
The road is narrow here, hemmed in by the city wall that blocks the way
ahead. A fallen building slumps beside the road, its timbers bowed and
black with damp. Grey weeds push between the cobbles, and the air tastes
of rot. The road bends on east, while the street opens out and runs back
south to the fountain.

9968.name: A North-South Street In Ghenna

north.description: To the north lies A Bend In The Road.

south.description: To the south lies A City Street In Ghenna.

9968.description:
A narrow lane runs between the towering city wall and the blind fronts
of crooked houses. A single door hangs beneath a lamp that glows a dull
and sullen red, staining the cobbles the colour of old wine. The paving
is greasy underfoot. The lane goes on north toward a bend and south
toward a wider street.

9969.name: A Bend In The Road

south.description: To the south lies A North-South Street In Ghenna.

west.description: To the west lies A Road In Ghenna.

9969.description:
The road makes a tight bend here, squeezed between the tall city wall
and a row of sagging shutters. Moss has crept over the stones and the
gutters hold a thin brown ooze. A cold draught slips along the wall,
carrying the smell of old smoke. A narrow lane runs south, and the road
runs back west the way you came.

9978.name: A Covered Walkway

north.description: To the north lies A City Street In Ghenna.

down.description: To the down lies A Slimey Footpath.

9978.description:
A covered walkway leads on into gloom, its timber roof black and beaded
with moisture. The air here is so humid it hangs in visible veils
between the posts. Wet planks sag underfoot and the lamps along it have
long since died. The street lies open to the north, and a steep slick
passage drops away downward into darkness.

9979.name: A Slimey Footpath

west.description: To the west lies A Slimey Footpath.

9979.description:
A footpath lies thick with a pale, ectoplasmic slime that shivers
faintly as you step. It is so slippery that you cannot climb back toward
the walkway above. Drips fall from the dank overhang, and the stench is
sweet and awful. The only way onward is west along the glistening path.

9980.name: A Slimey Footpath

north.description: To the north lies A Slimey Footpath.

east.description: To the east lies A Slimey Footpath.

9980.description:
The slime grows thicker as the path goes on, a glossy skin over the ruts
and stones. The bodies of beasts that slipped in and drowned lie half
sunk in it, their bones showing through. The ooze sucks at your boots at
every step. The footpath turns here, running north and back east.

9981.name: A Slimey Footpath

south.description: To the south lies A Slimey Footpath.

west.description: To the west lies A Slimey Footpath.

9981.description:
Slime lies everywhere on this stretch of path, and it is a thick and
dark red where it pools in the hollows. The stones are furred with it,
and it trails in ropes from the low branches overhead. It feels as
though the ground itself bleeds. The footpath leads south and west.

9982.name: A Slimey Footpath

east.description: To the east lies A Slimey Footpath.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Clearing.

9982.description:
The slime thins out a little here, though the footpath is still as slick
as wet glass. Patches of bare rock show through, spotted with pale
mould. Ahead the trees draw back, and a clearing shows beyond the last
bend. The path runs east the way you came and south toward the open
ground.

9983.name: A Small Clearing

north.description: To the north lies A Slimey Footpath.

south.description: To the south lies The Mouth Of A Small Cave.

9983.description:
Here the slime gives out and the ground turns to hard red clay, dotted
with a few lonely boulders. It is a rough, trampled track of some
primitive sort, packed down by many feet. The sky is low and sullen over
it. A dark opening in a rocky bank lies south, and the footpath leads
back north.

9984.name: The Mouth Of A Small Cave

north.description: To the north lies A Small Clearing.

down.description: To the down lies An Underground Cavern.

9984.description:
You stand at the mouth of a small cave, cut into the foot of a tall
promontory of rock. The stone around the opening is stained and slick
with seeping water. A rough-hewn stair leads down into the dark, damp
throat of the hill. The clearing lies back north in the grey light.

9985.name: An Underground Cavern

south.description: To the south lies A Long Sloping Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies The Mouth Of A Small Cave.

9985.description:
This small underground cavern is the dampest place imaginable. Moisture
trickles down the smooth rock in rivulets and drips steadily from the
ceiling onto your head. The air is warm and thick, and every sound
echoes. A rough stair climbs back to the cave mouth, and a passage runs
south into the dark.

9986.name: A Long Sloping Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies An Underground Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Long Sloping Tunnel.

9986.description:
A long tunnel slopes gently away in the dark. The smooth rock sweats as
if alive, and beads of water gather and run in the grooves of the floor.
The air is hot and heavy with damp. The tunnel leads north toward the
cavern and south deeper down.

9987.name: A Long Sloping Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Long Sloping Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Long Sloping Tunnel.

9987.description:
The tunnel continues to slope, its rounded walls slick with a cold shine
of moisture. Small pools have gathered in dips of the floor and drip
steadily. Somewhere ahead water trickles into a hollow. The passage runs
north and south through the dark.

9988.name: A Long Sloping Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Long Sloping Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Tunnel's End.

9988.description:
The slope eases here, and the sweating rock closes in on both sides. A
thin film of water covers the floor and your steps splash loudly. The
ceiling hangs low and glistens in the faint light. The tunnel goes on
south toward a wider place and back north.

9989.name: Tunnel's End

north.description: To the north lies A Long Sloping Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Wide Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies An East-West Tunnel.

9989.description:
The tunnel opens into a T shape here, with passages leading east and
west and the long slope running back north. The cavern is vaulted high
above you, fully twenty-five feet of dark that swallows your light.
Water ticks from unseen heights into shallow puddles. The air is cool
and still.

9990.name: An East-West Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Tunnel's End.

west.description: To the west lies An East-West Tunnel.

9990.description:
This tunnel is barely five feet high, a stoop to walk in. Moss-like
lichens hang from the ceiling and brush your face from time to time. The
rock is wet and cold to the touch. The tunnel continues east and west.

9991.name: An East-West Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies An East-West Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Under the bones..

9991.description:
The cramped tunnel runs on to a huge boulder that fills it from side to
side. Gaps beside the stone show a drift of old bones beyond. Cold air
stirs through the cracks. The tunnel leads back east, and a narrow
squeeze past the boulder goes west.

9992.name: A Wide Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies An Underground Cavern.

south.description: To the south lies A Bug Infested Crawlspace.

west.description: To the west lies Tunnel's End.

9992.description:
This tunnel is broader and easier to move through, but the turns have
left you unsure of your bearings. The rock is rough here and worn into
odd ridges. A hole in the rock opens to the south, and the tunnel leads
north toward the cavern and west toward a junction.

9993.name: A Bug Infested Crawlspace

north.description: To the north lies A Wide Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Swarming Lair.

9993.description:
You squeeze into a low crawlspace that is thick with insects, and they
crunch beneath your weight with every move. Dark husks and tangled webs
coat the rock. The ceiling presses on your back and the air is close and
sour. The crawl runs south into a hollow, and back north to the wide
tunnel.

9994.name: The Swarming Lair

north.description: To the north lies A Bug Infested Crawlspace.

east.description: To the east lies Under the bones..

west.description: To the west lies A Quivering Jaunt.

9994.description:
The crawlspace opens into a square hollow about ten feet across, thick
with the husks and trails of countless insects. Webs hang in grey
curtains from the low ceiling and the floor shifts with unseen movement.
The smell is dry and bitter. Ways lead north into the crawl, east toward
a pile of bones, and west into a trembling passage.

9995.name: A Quivering Jaunt

north.description: To the north lies A Quivering Jaunt.

9995.description:
You have entered a quivering passage that feels like the inside of some
vast beast. The walls are a deep red and thrum with a slow, sick energy,
and a warm wet breath moves along them. The floor gives under each step
like a soft cushion. The only way out leads north.

9996.name: A Quivering Jaunt

west.description: To the west lies The Lair Of The Deepspawn.

9996.description:
The whole passage heaves so much that you can scarcely keep your feet.
Red mucus hangs from the ceiling and walls in dark, dripping strings
that make your stomach turn. The air is hot and sweetish, and a low
pulse beats in the floor. A darker patch in the wall hints at the only
way on, leading west.

9997.name: The Lair Of The Deepspawn

east.description: To the east lies Under the bones..

south.description: To the south lies An Undulating Room.

west.description: To the west lies An Underground Cavern.

down.description: To the down lies The Temple Of Garathorm.

9997.description:
This is a lair some twenty feet across, its corners drifted with bones,
most of them plainly human. A great heap of treasure lies in the middle
of the floor, slick with the same red mucus that coats the walls. The
air is close and warm and thick with a deep rot. Ways lead east toward a
heap of bones, south into a heaving chamber, and west to a damp cavern,
while a dark way drops downward.

9998.name: A Dead End

north.description: To the north lies The Streets Of Ghenna.

east.description: To the east lies The Twisting Hedges.

9998.description:
The street comes to a dead end in a twisted mass of black brambles that
spills over the cobbles. The high city wall looms over you, close and
moss-streaked. Rot-sweet air gathers in the thorny corner. The only ways
out are north along the street and east into the hedges.
